name: hexacore-agent

tools.name: resume_session
tools.description: Call first in every session. Returns a briefing of where work stopped (unfinished plans, last QA results, recent decisions, last handoff, checkpoints) plus the workspace root and detected stacks.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: BM25 search (English/Spanish) over HexaCore rules, the project rules in .hexagen/rules/ and the ADRs in docs/adr/. Use before designing or changing code to respect conventions.

query.description: What you need to know, e.g. "repository layer rules for go"

tools.name: execute_scaffolding
tools.description: Generates a VSA slice (domain, application, infrastructure, presentation, composition module and tests) adapted to the host project. Never overwrites existing files unless overwrite=true; use dryRun=true to preview. Every write is recorded in a checkpoint (see rollback_changes).

layer.description: One layer only, or the full slice (default)

targetDir.description: Project directory relative to the workspace (monorepos)

dryRun.description: Return the planned files and their content without writing

tools.name: run_quality_assurance
tools.description: Runs the stack's native tools and returns structured results (counts, failing tests with file/line, diagnostics). checks: test (default), typecheck, lint, build. Checks whose tool isn't installed are reported as skipped, never as passed.

scope.description: Extra runner arguments, e.g. a test file or filter

cwd.description: Project directory relative to the workspace (default: where the stack was detected)

tools.name: check_architecture
tools.description: Read-only audit of the codebase against the VSA rules: cross-slice coupling, layer dependency direction (domain must not depend on outer layers…) and the 250-line file limit. Slices listed in hexacore.json architecture.compositionSlices may use other slices' public modules. Run after changing code.

path.description: Sub-directory to audit, relative to the workspace (default: whole workspace)

tools.name: orchestrate_task
tools.description: Executes a plan for a requirement: rules retrieval → scaffold each slice → architecture check → quality checks (with auto-fix through the client model when sampling is available). YOU decompose the requirement into slices; the plan is persisted and can be continued with resume_plan.

autoFix.description: Allow sampling-based fixes (default true when supported)

tools.name: resume_plan
tools.description: Continues a persisted plan from its first unfinished step (ids come from resume_session or orchestrate_task).

tools.name: list_checkpoints
tools.description: Lists recent checkpoints: every set of files HexaCore wrote (scaffolds, auto-fixes, ADRs, contracts), newest first.

tools.name: rollback_changes
tools.description: Restores every file of a checkpoint to its previous content (files it created are deleted). Refuses, changing nothing, if any of those files was edited afterwards unless force=true — confirm with the user before forcing.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Writes an ADR to docs/adr/NNNN-title.md and indexes it, so the decision is retrievable via search_knowledge_base in later sessions. Use when choosing between design alternatives.

context.description: The forces and constraints at play

tools.name: define_contract
tools.description: Contract-first design: writes contracts/<slice>.openapi.yaml (OpenAPI 3.1) from a list of operations, before implementing them.

tools.name: record_handoff
tools.description: Saves where this session stopped and what comes next; resume_session shows it to the next session. Call before ending a work session.

tools.name: record_lesson
tools.description: Turns experience into a reusable lesson in .hexagen/skills/ (indexed by search_knowledge_base and suggested automatically when a similar check fails). Call after fixing a failure that run_quality_assurance reported as resolved (pass its episodeId), or whenever you learn a project-specific fix or convention. Pass updateId to improve an existing lesson instead of duplicating it.

title.description: Short imperative name, e.g. "Register new Rust slices in mod.rs"

problem.description: When it applies: symptoms, error messages, situations

solution.description: What to do, as concrete steps or rules

example.description: A short code example or before/after

stack.description: Stack it applies to (default: the episode stack, else "any")

episodeId.description: The resolved failure this lesson was learned from

updateId.description: Lesson id to rewrite (keeps its usage history)

tools.name: rate_lesson
tools.description: Feedback on a lesson that was suggested to you (project lesson ids, or library:<id> for lessons from your other projects): helpful=true if it led to the fix, false if it was wrong or irrelevant. retire=true stops suggesting it (it stays on disk). Ratings and automatic outcomes drive ranking and export.

tools.name: review_lessons
tools.description: Maintenance view of what HexaCore has learned: resolved failures without a lesson yet (with recurrence counts), lessons whose evidence says they are not helping (rewrite with record_lesson updateId, or retire), near-duplicate lessons to merge (merge_lessons), lessons unused for months (still accurate?), proven lessons ready to export as skills or share with your other projects, the most effective lessons, and the lesson library from your other projects. With query, searches project and library lessons.

tools.name: merge_lessons
tools.description: Folds near-duplicate lessons (see review_lessons duplicates) into one. The surviving lesson (keepId) gets their usage evidence and history; the others are retired. Optionally rewrite the survivor with the best of both (fields left out keep its current text).

tools.name: export_skills
tools.description: Writes lessons as Claude Code skills (.claude/skills/hexacore-<name>/SKILL.md) so the client loads them natively. Without lessonIds exports every proven lesson (helped at least 3 times, at least 70% effective) not exported yet. Reversible through rollback_changes.

tools.name: share_lessons
tools.description: Copies proven project lessons to your lesson library (~/.hexacore/lessons/, or $HEXACORE_HOME), so your other projects with the same stack get them as suggestions after their own lessons. Without lessonIds shares every proven lesson that is new to the library or was rewritten since it was shared. Library lessons are scored by outcomes in every project that uses them.

tools.name: remember_preference
tools.description: Remembers how the user likes to work, so every future session starts with it (resume_session). Call when the user states a lasting preference or corrects you in a way that should stick: code style, conventions, workflow (e.g. "always show the plan before writing"), how they want answers. One sentence, phrased as guidance. scope user (default) follows them to every project; project applies here only. Never store secrets or personal data. replaceId rewrites one.

text.description: The preference, as guidance, e.g. "Prefers small PRs with one slice each"

tools.name: forget_preference
tools.description: Removes a remembered preference (id, from resume_session profile), or resets the observed habits (observed=true), or everything HexaCore knows about how the user works (all=true). Use when the user asks you to forget something or a preference is outdated.

instructions: HexaCore governs Vertical Slice Architecture across 11 stacks. Start every session with resume_session. Search rules (search_knowledge_base) before designing; preview scaffolds with dryRun; verify with run_quality_assurance and check_architecture; record design choices with record_decision and finish with record_handoff. All writes are checkpointed (rollback_changes).
